 Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) good to go Wednesday 
 by Leo Sells | Raptors Correspondent | Wed, Nov 11th 2026, 5:36pm EST 
 Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) is good to go for Wednesday night's game against the Boston Celtics. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Quickley was sidelined for two-straight games due to a hamstring issue, but he is better now and will make his return to the lineup on Wednesday night. Fantasy managers should expect him to be a good fantasy option moving forward, even if he's slightly limited for his first couple of games back.
